resources.string: Auto-pause — Trailscape is waiting for you to ride on
Trailscape isn’t allowed to access your location. Please allow access in the app settings and start recording again.
GPS is turned off. Please turn on location (quick settings or Settings → Location) and start recording again.
GPS was turned off — no new points are arriving. The ride so far is safe; as soon as you turn location back on, Trailscape continues recording by itself.
The recording couldn’t be written to storage.
The ride can no longer be written to storage — it’s probably full. For now Trailscape keeps recording in memory only; please free up space and stop the recording soon, otherwise points will be lost.

The running recording couldn’t be continued after the service restarted — Trailscape is NOT recording right now. The points collected until then are in your ride list as a recovered ride. Please start recording again.
The ride couldn’t be saved. It stays safe and will be saved again the next time the app starts.
